name: benchscout
description: Finds what is on your hardware bench, lets your AI agent work on the devices you pick, and asks you before anything changes device state.

benchscout.corePath.description: Path to the benchscout executable (your own settings only: a folder's settings cannot choose a program to run). Empty: the one bundled with the extension, else `benchscout` on PATH.

enumDescriptions: Not chosen yet: benchscout asks in the inbox
GitHub Copilot CLI, woken over ACP
Claude Code, woken with `claude -p` (your own install and sign-in)
benchscout.agent.description: Which agent benchscout wakes. benchscout never switches to another one on its own.

benchscout.maxTurnsPerHour.description: Budget: at most this many agent turns per hour; past it, benchscout pauses and says so.

enumDescriptions: Wake the agent when a chosen device crashes or resets (it is watched all along)
Only offer to investigate; the human decides
benchscout.autonomy.description: What benchscout does when it notices something on a watched device.

enumDescriptions: VS Code's display language, or the OS language when VS Code is in English
benchscout.language.description: The language the agent replies in (its reports and questions). benchscout's own words in the inbox are English, as in Claude Code and Copilot CLI.

scripts.package: npm run compile && vsce package --skip-license --allow-missing-repository -o benchscout.vsix

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In a folder you have not trusted, benchscout does not read the folder's own .benchscout/knowledge files or its memory file: a project from elsewhere could declare its actions safe.
